annotations.title: Extract values from JSON by path

description: Use when you need specific fields from a JSON document without reading all of it: $.users[0].name, $.items[*].id, $.a.b[-1], $.list[1:3], $..email (recursive). Returns each match with its exact path, type and value. Repairs the JSON first if needed, so broken input still works. Up to 100,000 characters.
name: mend_query_json
title: Extract values from JSON by path
